title: No Balance Left
approach: Payable amounts are the unbounded coin-reachability set over c; a balance H is solvable iff some payable x <= H leads to a solvable H - x + rebate(x). A rebate can exceed the spend, so the state graph has upward edges and cycles — the answer is a reachability closure from 0, not a one-pass DP.
